inputs.text: The city council in Phoenix went ahead and approved a plan on Wednesday night that restricts ICE and other law enforcement agencies from using city property. This is just another case of local officials undermining federal authority on immigration enforcement and putting national borders at risk. Instead of backing proper law and order, they're interfering with efforts to secure the country, which only encourages more illegal crossings and weakens the rule of law that holds society together. We need to reject this kind of local resistance and stand for traditional American sovereignty, personal responsibility, and strong federal control over our borders rather than letting progressive local politics erode cultural continuity and family security.
